A wonderful little animal hospital in Amsterdam West.
The doctors here make quick, accurate decisions and truly know their craft. They rotate, so sometimes you'll see a different doctor on a revisit—but since each one is highly knowledgeable, that's never a problem. All the tests for my dog ​​were done in-house, which made things efficient and reassuring.

Prices are fair, and I especially want to highlight the amazing support team. Even on busy days, they give their best and always manage to find a solution. I've never left disappointed.

Most importantly, in 2021 when my beloved Nelly passed away at 14, the staff were incredibly compassionate. They gave us a quiet room, so I could stay with her and say goodbye slowly and peacefully. That kindness is something I'll never forget.

DUTCH

A great animal hospital in Amsterdam West.
The doctors make quick and careful decisions and clearly have a lot of knowledge. Because they rotate, it is possible that you might see a different vet at a follow-up appointment, but that is never a problem: they are all skilled and dedicated. All the examinations for my dog ​​could be done in-house immediately, which gave me a lot of confidence.

The prices are reasonable, and I especially want to give a big compliment to the support team. Even on busy days, they do their utmost and always find a solution. I have never left here disappointed.

What remains most precious to me is their support in 2021, when my dog ​​Nelly passed away at the age of 14. I was given a quiet room where I could stay with her and say goodbye slowly. I will never forget that warmth and humanity.
